title: LINEST's Householder reflector stores each step from the x87 unit
statement: In Excel's QR route the reflector arithmetic behaves as stored precision-64 steps: v0 = x0 - alpha, v'v, each dot-product term, f = 2t/v'v, and a - f*v. With this change the row below gets Excel's last bits, where a plain binary64 reflector does not.
basis: Gains 11 recorded answers and loses none over the 3,944 regression rows of the corpus; 35 selections from two fits were checked directly.

repros.recorded_in: Excel 16.0.20527.20088 Current Channel, Windows 64-bit (NT 10.0.26200), x86-64, AMD Ryzen 7 4800H, en-ZA

open: Norm, rank, mean, pivot and back-substitution policies are not identified. 48 fixed rank policies and 240 rounded Gram/LDL rank labels are contradicted by the 241 recorded degrees-of-freedom observations.
